notes.title: Kickstarter Live, Demo Fixes/Updates, and Lots More!
notes.content:
Hello!


Wow, what a crazy week! Star Garden's Kickstarter launched on September 2 and was fully funded in just two hours. Thank you all so much for your support! 



If you're interested in preordering a copy of the full game at a discounted price, check out the link below:

Preorder today!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/cd5a3eb4beb083e3fd081c0de3a19dd32767a45d.png"]
We have a lot of news to cover here, but let's start with something really important...


If you played Star Garden: The Trial on Day 1, you may have ran into some nasty bugs that never came up for us while testing. We're extremely sorry for the inconvenience. However, these bugs were fixed a day later! We hope you give the demo another shot after updating, and please know that we are continuing to fix any bugs we find!



Click to join our Discord!



If you run into bugs, feel free to let us know on our official Discord! We're always looking! We never sleep!



In other news, if you didn't know, David Humphrey (who you may know as the original VA of a certain "Ultimate Lifeform") will be the voice of Lynx in Star Garden!



Is Lynx a friend or a foe? Find out in Story Mode when the full game releases!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/9bd78f68fdae31cbb54fe86f0af99f6e01cfca97.png"]

Also, Zeno Robinson will be voicing Jack Flash from ENDLESS FANTASIA as part of a FREE collab in Star Garden! ENDLESS FANTASIA is an awesome comic book that is also currently on Kickstarter. After the full game releases, we plan to release a FREE DLC collab pack for FREE!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/5ff51dea68bac18ab1ffaefe48bcf89b41c53cce.png"]

On our Kickstarter, we've hit a ton of our stretch goals. Thank you all so much! We're so close to our next one, which will add a new set of Lumi evolutions and a new vehicle type, the Air Skates! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322409/a25081226917ac57dc7b5057a08f80883b60f885.png"]We'll be sure to update you all more on our Steam page in the future! Seriously, we can't thank you enough for all your support so far!

notes.title: Wishlist Stretch Goal Update!
notes.content:
You’re all incredible! Star Garden has hit 2,600 wishlists on Steam in just 24 hours! To celebrate, four characters will be unlocked for FREE on all platforms at launch. We’ll reveal the designs for the two new characters soon. Let’s hit that final stretch goal together!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GdvaghiWYAALFFf?format=jpg&name=large

notes.title: Steam Wishlist Stretch Goals
notes.content:
Welcome to Star Garden! 💫

If Star Garden reaches certain wishlist goals on Steam, players on all platforms will receive FREE multiplayer characters! Please consider wishlisting the game and tell your friends!

As always, thank you all for your support!
